description: This file defines a React context provider component for managing shopping cart state, food list, and user token in a food ordering application. It includes functions for adding/removing items from the cart, fetching food data, and maintaining user session persistence.

methods.name: StoreContextProvider
methods.description: React functional component that provides context values related to shopping cart, food list, and user token.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds an item to the cart, updates state, and posts to server if token exists.

methods.name: removeFromCart
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart, updates state, and posts to server if token exists.

methods.name: getTotalCartAmount
methods.description: Calculates total price of items in the cart based on current food list.

methods.name: fetchFoodList
methods.description: Fetches the list of food items from server and updates state.

methods.name: loadcartData
methods.description: Loads cart data from server using provided token.
